description: A reusable, named bundle of effect Actions a Step node runs against workflow state and the subject. Declares its read/write contract on state (reads/writes) so a workflow can be checked for a missing producer at author time.

fields.label: Group Name
fields.description: Names the reusable action bundle so multiple workflows may reference it.

fields.label: Reads
fields.description: Documentation only: the state keys this group reads (comma-separated). Not enforced - a note for the author, not an author-time check.

fields.label: Writes
fields.description: Declares the state keys the group writes (comma-separated).

fields.label: Actions
fields.description: The actions this group runs, in order, when a Flow's Step node references it. Each is one effect verb - Update Field, Create Task, Create Note, Append/Upsert Child Row, Call Webhook, Send WhatsApp, or Send Email - over an allowlisted field or a curated endpoint. A group is built and corrected once here and reused by any Flow.

name: CRM Action Group
